open_points.subject: PortRef capture input variants
open_points.text: The functions capability keeps the broad PortRef input contract.
open_points.question: Which module owns the PortRef contract and the definitions and construction rules for FileFactsRef, StoredValuesRef and SpooledFilesRef shared between runs and functions?
options: models owns the shared typed reference variants; runs constructs them and functions applies capture validation
functions owns a capture-specific PortRef contract and runs depends on that contract
runs owns the reference variants it passes and functions consumes them
open_points.default_guess: models owns the shared typed reference variants; runs constructs them and functions applies capture validation
